cloud-service.criteria.free.en: Log in with any Cardinal account to use this.

cloud-service.criteria.subscribed.en: Log in with a subscribed Cardinal account to use this.

pdp.desc.en: Allow this media server to join the Popularity Data Pool and contribute anonymous play counts. Your media apps will also use the pool's data with your own media to display trends.

pdp.confirm-disable.desc.en: Leaving the Popularity Data Pool will disable trend data in your Music and Cinema apps.

ra.desc.en: Enable remote access for this media server to reach your self-hosted apps from anywhere.

ra.request-access.desc-p1.en: Remote Access is currently a beta feature that is available to a limited number of users. Once enabled, you will remain in a queue until there is room for your media server. There is a maximum of one (1) media server per user during the beta.

ra.request-access.desc-p2.en: Inactive servers may be pruned from the beta. If that happens to you, feel free to queue up again.

ra.access.granted.en: Your account is approved for this

ra.access.queued.en: Your account is queued for this

ra.queued.desc.en: This server is queued for Remote Access.

ra.confirm-disable.desc.en: This media server will stop being reachable from outside your network, and its remote URLs will stop working.

ra.upnp.reason.port_conflict.en: No free external port on the router

ra.upnp.reason.no_gateway.en: No UPnP gateway found on this network

ra.upnp.docker-bridge-banner.en: UPnP requires host networking. Switch your compose template to enable automatic port forwarding.

ra.auth-failed.desc.en: Cardinal Cloud rejected this media server's credentials. Sign in again to re-enable Remote Access.

ra.not-approved.desc.en: This media server is queued for Remote Access. It keeps asking on its own and connects as soon as Cardinal approves your account.

ra.suspended.desc.en: Cardinal staff suspended Remote Access for this account. Signing in again will not lift it. The media server keeps retrying on its own and reconnects if the suspension is lifted.

ra.cors.desc.en: Let your own web apps at these origins call this media server remotely.

ra.cors.invalid.en: Enter a valid http:// or https:// origin without a path

ra.cors.duplicate.en: That origin is already on the list

ra.cors.confirm-delete.desc.en: Apps served from this origin will lose remote access to this media server.
